title: Review: stoa full-project idiomatic Rust
notes:
small crates (auth/lmdb/verify/tls/sieve-native/imap/ctl) idiom rating: ACCEPTABLE — well-structured with good separation of concerns, strong test coverage, and correct security decisions (timing equalization, verify_strict, DP glob matcher); main issues are missing SAFETY comment on the one unsafe block in lmdb (P0), STARTTLS absent from plain IMAP port (P0), SQLite missing create_if_missing (P0), several missing derives and error-type inconsistencies (P1), no REWRITE-level structural problems.
core crate idiom rating: ACCEPTABLE — solid architecture (typestate verification, wildmat DP, cfg-gated escape hatches) undermined by missing derives on key types, stringly-typed errors in signing/secret modules, one P0 bug (temp file name collision in write_signing_key), and process::exit in library code; all findings are mechanical fixes.
mail crate idiom rating: B+ — Well-structured with good separation of JMAP concerns, strong test coverage, proper use of sqlx, and correct constant-time bearer token comparison. Main weaknesses: three P0 panics (unwrap on serde_json::to_value in two handlers and a mailboxIds type confusion), two stringly-typed config fields, and a dead synchronous Dispatcher abstraction. Efficiency issues are minor (triple CID allocation, per-call reqwest::Client). Nothing architecturally broken.
smtp crate idiom rating: B — Strong protocol implementation (RFC-correct dot-stuffing, SASL PLAIN guards against plaintext, correct retry/dead-letter queue, constant-time bearer token). Weaknesses: process::exit inside async library fn (P3), stringly-typed dns_resolver/log.format (P1), InboundAuthResult missing Debug (P1), RootCertStore rebuilt per TLS connection (P3), Debug format in wire header value (P3). No P0 panics. The relay subsystem (relay_client, relay_error, relay_health, relay_queue) is particularly well-designed.
reader crate idiom rating: ACCEPTABLE — 3 P0 correctness bugs (double-code NNTP response, group_select 211 on name validation failure, TOCTOU admin bind), 1 P0 silent data loss (metrics UTF-8 drop), several P1 type-design issues (stringly-typed config, bool params, Box<dyn Error> in internal fns, auth helpers returning raw strings, cross-function .expect invariants), and consistent P3/P4 boilerplate debt (missing derives, duplicated header-boundary parsers). The backend stores (LMDB, RocksDB, Fs, SQLite, PG, S3, Azure, GCS, Git, WebDAV) are uniformly well-structured with good test coverage. The session command loop and pipeline are solid. The P0 bugs are the priority.
transit crate idiom rating: ACCEPTABLE — well-structured with good test coverage, async hygiene, and security defaults; notable issues are: timing oracle in trusted-key scan (.any() short-circuits ct_eq), blacklist TOCTOU, bytes-limit TOCTOU in ingestion queue, KuboStore returning wrong error variant, admin VACUUM INTO format-string SQL, and seven P1 correctness/safety bugs total; significant code duplication (TokenBucket, dot-stuffing, response-code parser, SPKI header constant, cert expiry logic) and stringly-typed API surfaces (PinRule action, gc_reason) bring it below CLEAN
